concerns.text: T002 outputs bcc_filtered.csv/bcc_aggregated.csv 'conforming to contracts/bcc_alloy.schema.yaml (SC-005)', but the schema requires yield_definition, source_reference, and processing_status (with additionalProperties: false). No task or sub-step populates or validates these required fields, so the declared schema conformance in T002 cannot be satisfied as written. Add explicit population/validation of these fields to T002 (or its tests).

T008 assembles results.json 'for all three models' including feature_importance, feature_stability, and practical_utility per results.schema.yaml, but T006 computes permutation importance and stability metrics only for the best-performing model. No task produces feature_importance/feature_stability for the two non-best models, leaving required per-model fields uncoverable. Either extend T006 to all models or scope T008's per-model output to the fields actually produced.
